items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: if I was able to have a band, I would like to have Ernest as a first guitarist.

ctx.x: Now okay, a guitar is entitled to a soloist, well as nobody else in a band. If he's a soloist, and Ernest is one, I'll tell you what, if I was able to have a band, I would like to have Ernest as a first guitarist. All I want to do is play rhythm. But I want to feature him on solo. Circus solo. For St. Joe.

To get back to your rhythm guitar, one of those are our banjo. There was a banjo player who came over here from England last year. Nice enough guy and knew the instruments fairly well. But he was always going plenka, plenka, plenka, plenka back and forth always a double stroke. Yes, yes. Well, usually do you just hit thumb the down stroke? Of course you have that more different style in your guitar. Yeah. That bass.
